name: THE AWG FOUNDATION
role: A former life built on a thrifted laptop w/ GIMP.
lines: This zine was made with Ephemera Eternal, a Ziner fork. All photographs on loan from Adam Goldman.

Glenn S. Ritchey III is a PhD student in the Texts & Technology program at UCF. Their work focuses on electronic literature, digital privacy, and open-source creative tools, especially for "writing in the expanded field" (Inside the Castle 2014).
